page.layout: One printed page. Main text in one column on the right; a narrow column of marginal notes on the left, running alongside the text. Page number and running head at the top. Section numeral XVIII. at the left of the text block, with the note column beside it. A closing numeral XIX. at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: fua demonstratione de corporum exiſtentia, meminit facultatum quarundam paſſivarum ſentiendi vel ideas recipiendi; nec non & alia- rum aſtivarum facultatum ideas producendi vel efficiendi, non subiit ejus mentem cogita- tio de distinͤtionis ejus summa utilitate & neceßitate, ſi prius eam ad facultates ſuperiores, quæ Deum reſpiciunt, & ad ration- nem noftram, retulisset & applicuisset.

XVIII. Plura erra-X. VIII. Ex his omnibus crediderim a- bunde conflare, quantum vel maxima ingenia a veritate aberrent, quando nonnullis Methodi cujufdam minus præcipuis regulis confisi, a sex illis neceßariis & præcipuis, quæ a nobis commendatæ sunt, aut a quibusdam illarum recedunt. Fuisse enim Cartefium feculi sui maximum ingenium: Meditationes autem ejus, omnium, quæ reliquit, operum, elaboratiffimum, ipsique præ cæteris charißimum, nemo est, opinor, qui ignoret. Sed multo plura tristiorum erratorum exempla ex discipulis ejus nonnullis defumi possent, qui nec eum æquarunt ingenio, nec eadem, qua ipse, fuerunt modestia, ut divino lumini revelationique rationem ejusque claram distinctamque perceptionem postponendam esse agnoscerent; & vero qui errores ejus assumptos eo extremitatis urferunt, ex iisque novos ac tantos eduxerunt, ut nil sacrum jam sit quod non ab aliquo fuerit violatum, & quod impositum tutum sit ab impotentissimæ rationis corruptæ temeraria invasione & nefanda violatione, ubi fræna sibi femel laxaverit.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left, in small type, transcribed as printed: "Plura erra- rata & pernicio- sa ... non pauci Cartesii confisi ... commit- tuntur ... ob neglectum verum ... rarum regularum". Several words are too cramped to read with certainty and are left as read. The marginal note text was printed in fragments across lines and is given here only in part.
